title: The 100-Tool Agent Is a Trap - Sohail Shaikh & Ankush Rastogi, Prosodica
talk_summary: The talk argues that loading every tool schema into every agent prompt causes context overload, latency, cost, and tool-selection errors as catalogs grow. It proposes semantic routing of tool descriptions plus just-in-time injection of only top-K relevant schemas, with logging, fallback, and evaluation.

takeaways.evidence_quote: It retrieves the three to five most relevant tool, and then it injects only those into the model call.
takeaways.numbers: 741 tools -> 127k tokens; accuracy 78% at 10 tools, 40% at 100, 13.6% at 741; router >83%; 3-5 schemas ~1k tokens (~99% reduction); K=5 default.

takeaways.evidence_quote: It will wait until the query is known, then it will inject only the context needed for that request.
takeaways.numbers: Anthropic MCP report: 150k tokens down to 2k, 98.7% reduction.

takeaways.what_they_do: Log selected tools, actual tool calls, failures, and fallback usage; evaluate K=3/5/10 on a real test set and pick the smallest K meeting accuracy.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Log selected tools, final tool calls, failure, and fallback usage.
takeaways.numbers: K swept at 3, 5, 10; K=5 recommended as strong default.

takeaways.what_they_do: If the model cannot complete the task, widen K, run a second retrieval pass, or route to a broader tool group.
takeaways.evidence_quote: If the model cannot complete the task, you could widen K, run a second retrieval pass, or even route it to a broader tool group.

takeaways.what_they_do: Write tool descriptions using words users actually use, including intent, action, and key entities, and re-embed when descriptions or schemas change.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Write descriptions in the words users actually use and include intent, action, and key entities along with it.

takeaways.technique: Do not route small tool sets
takeaways.what_they_do: Keep static tool loading for small catalogs; add routing only when prompt size, latency, or tool confusion is a real production problem.
takeaways.evidence_quote: If you have fewer than 20 tools, a router may be unnecessary. Just load the tools directly.
takeaways.numbers: Router generally pays off past 50 tools; under 20 tools static loading may be fine.
